scientific_integrity: The all-order inequality is proved analytically. The six-vertex sharpness bound uses exhaustive exact finite computation with a standalone checker. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted finite trees, uniform feasible-edge selection only.
Infinite positive family restricted to S(2,2,L) with L at least 2.
The 1991 original Dyer–Frieze full text was not available for complete comparison; its abstract was examined.
title: A sharp seven-vertex obstruction and an infinite KC-shift counterfamily for random greedy matching
